text:
## Description

For each input sequence, report the minimum total number of adjacent swaps and equal-valued prefix deletions needed to make the sequence empty. Each swap or deletion counts as one operation, regardless of how many elements the deletion removes.

## Preconditions

- **PRE-1 (Unverified)** — Standard input contains an integer \(T\) from 1 through \(10^5\), followed by exactly \(T\) test cases in the specified format.
- **PRE-2 (Unverified)** — Each case contains an integer \(N\) from 2 through \(2 \times 10^5\), followed by \(N\) integers \(A_1,\ldots,A_N\), each from 1 through \(N\).
- **PRE-3 (Unverified)** — The sum of \(N\) across all test cases is at most \(2 \times 10^5\).

## Postconditions

- **POST-1 (Unverified)** — A legal swap exchanges two neighboring elements of the current sequence and preserves its length and value multiplicities. A legal deletion removes a nonempty prefix whose elements all have the same value and preserves the relative order of the remaining elements. Any such prefix is eligible, including a single element or the entire sequence when all elements are equal.
- **POST-2 (Unverified)** — For each case, the reported integer is the total count of a legal sequence of operations that reaches the empty sequence. No legal sequence with fewer operations reaches it. The answer is between 1 and \(N\), inclusive.
- **POST-3 (Unverified)** — Standard output contains one answer per line in input order. Each case is evaluated independently, and identical cases produce identical answers.

## Test suggestions

- For the minimum allowed length, check that \((1,1)\) yields 1 and \((1,2)\) yields 2. Also check that an all-equal sequence at the maximum allowed length yields 1. (PRE-2, PRE-3, POST-1, POST-2)
- Check the three supplied sample cases together and expect 3, 4, and 8 on consecutive lines. The first case exercises a swap that improves the result. (POST-1, POST-2, POST-3)
- Submit \(10^5\) length-two cases alternating between \((1,1)\) and \((1,2)\). Check the output count and that answers alternate between 1 and 2. (PRE-1, PRE-2, PRE-3, POST-3)

## Unspecified behavior

The task leaves malformed or out-of-range input unspecified. When multiple operation sequences attain the minimum, it requires only the count and leaves the choice among them unspecified.

generation.note: Harness wall time includes Codex startup; not API latency.

usage.note: Codex token counts include its harness context; not comparable to API usage.

isolation.mechanism: codex exec, fresh ephemeral session, empty temporary working directory, user config and exec rules ignored, read-only sandbox, web search and listed features disabled, credential-like variables removed from the environment
isolation.limits: Codex harness instructions and its own tool descriptions remain in the model context; they cannot be removed. Tool isolation is verified post hoc from the event stream, which contained no tool, command, file or search events.
